[[File:Laser_gates.png|thumb|275px|The duel between [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] is interrupted by laser barriers in the [[Plasma Refinery Complex]].]]

'''Laser gates''', also known as '''electron walls''', were designed to protect high-security or dangerous areas by sealing them off with a wall of energy.

Laser gates were installed in the [[Plasma Refinery Complex]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The barriers were strong enough to easily block a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strike and would vaporize any matter that touched them. However, the generators were unable to keep up the immense energy needed to power the gates, and so they would cycle on and off approximately every five minutes. Each gate remained open for only around ten seconds before cycling on again.

These gates were crucial to the death of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] at the hands of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], as they prevented Jinn's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], from coming to his aid against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].
